title: Integrative identification of immune-related key genes in atrial fibrillation using weighted gene coexpression network analysis and machine learning.
summary: WGCNA, LASSO and SVM-RFE identified GALNT16, HTR2B, BEX2 and RAB8A; ROC AUCs 0.836–0.893 and expression was further checked in AF samples by qRT-PCR. External replication and prospective utility were not established.
